confidence_note: all numbers are quoted from the first-party Cloud Build pricing, quotas and free-features pages; no build was run, so the behaviour of a worker during a build, the exact rate of standard network egress and what happens after the 2,500 monthly minutes are spent are unverified

free_tier.stated: Each billing account comes with 2,500 free build-minutes per month on e2-standard-2 (2 vCPU, 8 GB memory) in the default pool; the first 100GB of worker SSD is free. The build-minute allowance is promotional and its limit is subject to change
free_tier.notes: the unit counts minutes a build is in process, not one unit per build; a one-minute build and a sixty-minute build each spend minutes from the same 2,500 per billing account. A Google Cloud billing account is required to reach the Free Tier

per_object_cap.stated: the first 100GB of extra worker SSD is free, and up to 4000GB can be requested; no cap on a single artifact or build input is stated on the pages read

retention.stated: unverified: the pricing, quotas and free-features pages read state no retention period for build logs, artifacts or the build worker

egress.terms: network egress is charged according to standard Google Cloud rates; no Cloud Build egress allowance or own price is stated

interface_detail: builds are submitted with gcloud builds submit (the Google Cloud CLI) and the Cloud Build REST API at cloudbuild.googleapis.com; build triggers connect a Git repository. No SSH into a build worker is documented on the pages read
tooling: the gcloud CLI and the Cloud Build REST API; the user supplies a cloudbuild.yaml build configuration and a source archive or a connected repository
chaining: a build runs to completion on a Google-managed worker in the default pool and its result is published to Google Cloud services; a repository trigger, the CLI or the REST API starts each build and each build-minute spends the monthly allowance. No per-build step is a separate hosted runner

limits.value: 2,500 free build-minutes per month per billing account on e2-standard-2 in the default pool; beyond it e2-standard-2 costs $0.006 per minute
10 to 30 concurrent builds in the default pool, counted globally as a project quota
the first 100GB of worker SSD is free, up to 4000GB can be requested

limits_note: partial minutes are billed at the actual number of seconds consumed, and minutes a build spends queued are not billed
binding_note: the 2,500 monthly build-minutes are shared across every project on a billing account and are spent by every build in process, so an active account reaches the promotional allowance before the 10 to 30 concurrent-build quota binds

identity_cost.detail: a Google Cloud billing account is required for the Free Tier; the Free Trial sign-up that creates one requires a credit card or other payment method valid for the trial, and in some countries a bank account verification

reliability_note: the pricing page calls the 2,500-minute allowance promotional and subject to change; no ban or data-loss event is recorded on the pages read
